description: Supplementary materials to Rana et al. (2022), "Global magnitude-frequency statistics of the failures and impacts of large water-retention dams and mine tailings impoundments", Earth-Science Reviews. The Borealis record holds a new database of tailings storage facility (TSF) failures from 1965 to 2020 with coordinates, altitude and surface area; a calculation sheet converting global mineral commodity production into estimated tailings volumes and numbers of TSFs built; an incomplete database of large reservoir facility failures with upper and lower bound estimates; KMZ files locating failed TSFs and mapping their surface areas; a supplementary article; and a zip of GIS-processed satellite and aerial images of past failures (about 476 MB). Version 2.0 was released on 2 August 2022 and updated on 3 August 2022, free under CC0 1.0, under the CanBreach Data Archive. Coverage is worldwide. Caveats: the reservoir failure list is stated to be incomplete, and the number of constructed TSFs is extrapolated between bounds, not counted. For simulation it gives failure frequencies and return periods for tailings dams and reservoirs, to set base rates in dam-failure and mining hazard models. Related catalogue records include the global database of tailings flows, the WISE chronology of tailings dam failures and the Global Tailings Portal.
